title: How much does DOOH advertising cost? | AdQuick

facts.fact: DOOH advertising CPMs typically range from $3 to $20, though premium placements like Times Square or major airports can exceed $50.
facts.quote: DOOH advertising CPMs typically range from $3 to $20, though premium placements like Times Square or major airports can exceed $50.

facts.fact: Monthly digital billboard costs run from $1,200 in smaller markets to $15,000 or more in major cities.
facts.quote: Monthly digital billboard costs run from $1,200 in smaller markets to $15,000 or more in major cities.

facts.fact: Programmatic DOOH campaigns generally require a minimum spend of $10,000 to $50,000.
facts.quote: Programmatic campaigns generally require a minimum spend of $10,000 to $50,000.

facts.fact: On AdQuick, campaigns built on multi-format ran a median of $39,300 in total campaign spend, based on 80 campaigns.
facts.quote: Campaigns built on multi-format ran a median $39,300 in total campaign spend, with a typical range of $14,200 to $68,450 (80 campaigns).

facts.fact: On AdQuick, the typical (25th to 75th percentile) range of multi-format campaign spend is $14,200 to $68,450.
facts.quote: with a typical range of $14,200 to $68,450 (80 campaigns)

facts.fact: Programmatic DOOH CPMs range from $3 to $20, depending on inventory quality and location.
facts.quote: Programmatic DOOH: $3 to $20, depending on inventory quality and location

facts.fact: Digital billboard CPMs are listed at $5 to $10.
Smaller screens in high-traffic but non-premium locations such as subways or gas stations have CPMs of $2 to $6.
facts.quote: Smaller screens in high-traffic but non-premium locations such as subways or gas stations: $2 to $6

facts.fact: Premium urban placements at major airports or iconic intersections have CPMs of $50 or more.
facts.quote: Premium urban placements at major airports or iconic intersections: $50 or more

facts.fact: Indoor digital mall screens typically cost $750 to $2,500 per month.
facts.quote: Indoor screens in malls typically run $750 to $2,500 per month

facts.fact: Digital supermarket screens cost roughly $800 to $1,500 per month.
facts.quote: digital supermarket screens run roughly $800 to $1,500 per month

facts.fact: Small business DOOH campaigns can begin as low as $1,000 to $5,000 per month depending on location and network.
facts.quote: some small business campaigns begin as low as $1,000 to $5,000 per month depending on location and network

facts.fact: Local or regional DOOH campaigns negotiated directly can start below $10,000.
facts.quote: Local or regional campaigns negotiated directly can start below $10,000

facts.fact: National multi-city DOOH campaigns generally require $50,000 or more to achieve meaningful scale and frequency.
facts.quote: National multi-city campaigns generally require $50,000 or more to achieve meaningful scale and frequency.

facts.fact: Programmatic DOOH spending is projected to grow from $6.83 billion to $12.88 billion by 2030.
facts.quote: Programmatic DOOH spending is projected to grow from $6.83 billion to $12.88 billion by 2030

facts.fact: Page's worked example: a $10,000 budget at a $5 CPM yields approximately 2 million impressions.
facts.quote: A $10,000 budget at a $5 CPM yields approximately 2 million impressions.
